title: Deep learning alert system speeds and improves pneumothorax detection on chest radiographs
summary: A deep learning model trained on 1,235 pneumothorax and 337 negative radiographs powered an automated alert system run in parallel with the manual system on 3,739 prospectively acquired emergency radiographs. Sensitivity was 0.837 versus 0.256, AUC 0.914 versus 0.628, and PPV 0.686 versus 1.000; mean alert time fell from 8.45 to 0.69 min. It is a single tertiary center and the comparator is manual alerting.
ai_technology: Deep learning model for pneumothorax detection on chest radiographs

evidence.tested: Prospective parallel run in the emergency department from September to October 2020.
evidence.unknown: Multi-center performance and patient outcomes are not reported; full text not reviewed.
